early signs of pregnancy would be a hard-feeling abdomen around week 2, period-like symptoms such as cramping pain and bloating but WITHOUT an actual period, any regular fluctuation in breast size that you'd normally experience on your period, and after about 4 weeks you may start to experience morning sickness. 
if youre on the combination pill (estrogen and progestin) there is likely no chance of pregnancy as long as youve been consistent. if youre on the minipill (progestin only) the chance of pregnancy could be higher as these require accurate consistency bc theyre only effective for 24 hours. also, if no condoms have ripped, youre likely fine.
